gain_output: unrestricted real, same architecture as v1; permits negative gain
selection: minimum task-state-action weighted dev functional MSE; exact tie chooses fewer epochs
prior: training-task mean of within-task skill/stage means; unseen combination returns zero
ablation: independently initialized/fitted task-only and full heads; exact common candidates and actual payloads
cross_fit_unit: public mechanism family, including all sibling tasks
all_zero_train_deltas: PARTIAL_METHOD; zero/prior diagnostics only, no fitted gain/wait claim

myopic: same full gain weights, wait call disabled
